proposedDiagnosticsOnly: Keep account_url, popup_url, account_entry, account_home and account_completed behavior unchanged. Do not add any country or endpoint to navigation admission.

In account_stage only, distinguish exact accounts.google.<official suffix> hosts using a frozen, attributed Chromium GOOGLE_TLD_LIST-derived set. This data is diagnostic classification only; it must not be called by account_url or grant account, popup or IPC permissions.

After the existing exact accounts.google.com category, classify a recognized regional accounts host plus exact case-sensitive /accounts/SetSID as the constant google-regional-transfer. Classify the same recognized regional accounts host with any other path as the constant google-regional-account-other. Never return a suffix, host, path, query, title, identity or user-controlled value.

Preserve the existing HTTPS/credentials/nonstandard-port guard and the64-event cap. Add only those two fixed strings to SafeFields account_step. Keep existing categories stable, including other for unrecognized hosts and all www transfer denials.

No forced navigation, response replay, synthetic SetSID request in the user profile, cookie/token extraction, challenge submission, security bypass, changed account profile, new-window admission or browser refresh.
testPlan: Known co.kr, ro, fr and co.uk regional accounts hosts with exact /accounts/SetSID classify as google-regional-transfer, while account_url remains false for every one.

The same known hosts with other paths, path case differences, extra trailing slash and percent-encoded spelling classify as google-regional-account-other, never the transfer category and never admitted.

Foreign suffixes, accounts.google.com.evil.test, accounts.google.evil.test, extra subdomains and user-info tricks do not classify as a trusted regional host. HTTP and nonstandard ports retain rejection.

Known region classification is independent of opaque query/fragment values; sentinel credentials in test URLs never appear in diagnostic output. Invalid and arbitrary strings are rejected by the SafeFields fixed-enum validator.

A table snapshots all current account_url positives and negatives, including www SetSID denial, so a diagnostics-only change cannot accidentally widen admission. Existing exact-home/fresh-observation/nonce/epoch/recording fences remain tested.

Actual later fresh authentication must retain fixed category/allowed/load events and demonstrate official home plus observed native destruction without F5 before reporting the requested problem fixed. No user question is sent overnight.
